extraction.name: VAP-Data
extraction.description: The largest dataset for semantic-controlled video generation, containing over 100K paired video samples across 100 semantic conditions spanning concept (entity transformation and interaction), style, motion (human and non-human), and camera movement.
extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The authors collected 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet across categories including men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases. They then used Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs to generate paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, Software Collection, Web API
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 2K high-quality reference images gathered from the Internet, combined with Image-to-Video templates from commercial platforms (VIDU, Kling) and community LoRAs (Civitai).
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Videos are resized to 480 × 720 (or 832) resolution and sampled at 49 frames at 16 frames per second.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Standard descriptive video captions are provided for reference and target videos to aid in finding and transferring shared semantic control signals.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Images depicting human subjects including men, women, and children.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Risks include identity impersonation, deepfake content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media. Mitigations include research-only licensing and default content filters blocking harmful categories.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is synthetic and derived from other generative models and LoRAs, which may cause it to inherit specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates (e.g., poor generation of hands).
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Semantic conditions are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models; generation quality degrades when semantic descriptions are inaccurate or subject structures mismatch; generic captions can cause spurious blending of visual details when multiple reference videos are supplied.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, validation, and testing for semantic-controlled video generation models; research, education, and creative prototyping. Not intended for surveillance, impersonation, political persuasion, or other high-risk deployments.
